title: Board guard refuses npm/yarn in a pnpm project
notes: The rule "use pnpm, never npm/yarn" is in 3 md files. The PreToolUse guard can refuse a Bash npm/yarn install/run when the project has pnpm-lock.yaml, with the reason. Then delete the md rule from each file. Found by the md audit, 2026-11-17.

comments.body: PR #319: package-manager guard in board guard; rule deleted from /work-card (work-card-skill.ts). Only that one md file in this repo stated the rule. The dotfiles agents dependency-updater.md and dependency-update-fleet.md detect the manager by lockfile as a procedure step, not a rule, and live outside this worktree, so they were left as they are.
Pull request #319 opened: board guard refuses another package manager than the lockfile names https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/319

PR #319 not ready to merge: it now conflicts with main in src/main/workflow/running-app-guard.ts (main's pane-send changes, 800e0a7d/b2ff2328, landed during the loop), so GitHub runs no CI on the head (3bd9ab74). Done: the card file now matches main's copy (467a0e5a). Global installs (-g/--global/--location=global) now go through, with tests for globals, dlx/exec one-off runs, a folder with no lockfile and the nearest lockfile in a monorepo (a1f824a5). The review loop ran 2 rounds and ended floor-addressed with 4 findings, all fixed (7b85cf8a: only installs are refused, not script runs, and only inside a git repo; 72a4047d: npm's install aliases), nothing left open. Windows CI failed on the test fakes' path separator; fixed in 5d46cd3d, unverified by CI so far. Next: resolve the conflict (/pr-conflicts 319), then CI.
